## Bvh.kt { #bvh-kt }

Motion capture in BVH format: a joint hierarchy and one line of channel values per frame.

`Bvh.read` parses a file; [`Bvh.positions`](io.md#bvh-kt--bvh--positions) runs forward kinematics to give every joint's position
(and every end site's: fingertips, toes, the top of the head) at a frame. [`Bvh.toTrajectory`](io.md#bvh-kt--bvh--totrajectory)
turns a take into a [`Trajectory`](math.md#trajectory-kt-trajectory) of joint positions for analysis or sequence memory, optionally
in the performer's own frame (travel and turning removed), and [`Bvh.skeleton`](io.md#bvh-kt--bvh--skeleton) draws a pose as
3D FLines for `three(...)`. Tests: `BvhTest`.
